He or She that commits sin is of the devil, I John 3:8 (I John 3:8). If you are into lust, masturbation, fornication, adultery, prostitution (private or public), patronizing prostitutes, abortion, lesbianism, homosexuality, bestiality, watching pornography ﻿ (I Corinthians 6:9-10), immoral thoughts or any act of immorality, you need to repent (Galatians 5:19-21; Mathew 5:28; Mark 7:21-23). What therefore God has joined together let no man put asunder (separate)’. Cheating on your wife or husband is sin. Proverbs 28: 13 says, ‘‘He that covers his sins shall not prosper...You must repent of them, confess and forsake them (1 John 1:9).
Are you into worldliness? Don’t you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? (James 4:4; II John2:15-17). So, you must stop bleaching your body or painting your mouth, eyes, hands and legs or fixing attachments, weave-on, earrings (Genesis 35:2-4), bangles, chains and frying or perming your hair. Jeremiah 4:30 says, ‘‘And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee. They will seek thy life’’. (2 Kings 9:30; Hosea 2:13; Exodus 33:1-6)
A Christian is not a Sinner and a Sinner is not a Christian (I John 3:9). If you must be a blessed child of God, then you must repent of your sins and give your life to Jesus Christ. If you believe Jesus Christ today, righteousness of God will come into your life and abundant life will be your portion (1 John 11-12). If you neglect this call to repentance and salvation and die, you will not escape fire of Hell (Hebrews 2:3). It is foolishness and sin to say or think that there is no God (Psalm 14:1; 9:17). Luke 13:3, Jesus said, ‘I tell you, Nay: but except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish’. Cut off every besetting sin (Hebrew 12:1-2; Mark 9:43-48).
If you have decided now (2 Corinthians 6:2) to give your life to Jesus Christ and to forsake your sinful lifestyle, please say this prayer:
Almighty God, I come unto you in the name of Jesus. Father I confess that I am a sinner. All my sins I confess to you.
I am very sorry for all my sins (mention those you can remember). Lord I promise you that from today I will never continue in them anymore. I believe that Jesus Christ died and rose again on the third day for my justification.
Almighty God, use the blood of Jesus to wash my sins away. Lord Jesus, come into my heart, be my Lord and personal Saviour. I surrender my life to you. Cancel my name from the books of death and write it in the book of life. Give me power to sin no more. In Jesus name I pray. Amen!!

1John 1:9 If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. 
Hell is a place of torment forever...continuous burning by fire. The fire is never quenched, with crying and weeping forever (Mark 9:43-48; Psalm 9:17; Mathew 25:41). It was originally prepared for satan and his demons, but anybody that obeys the devil in committing sin and refuse to repent and accept Jesus Christ, if the person dies in sins, he or she will be thrown into Hell. You still have the opportunity to repent now, amend your ways, live and spend eternity in heaven. 

You may be asking; how do I stop all these sins? Simply take the first step of repentance and have inner hatred for those sins, then ask Jesus to forgive you and come into your life to be your Lord and personal Saviour. In John 1:12, there is power that will be given to you, and in Mathew 11:28, if you receive Jesus into your life, He will deliver you and give you victory over those sins; then you will need to cut off from the source of those sins in your life (may be sinful friends; stop the evil relationship). 
This gospel is not to condemn you, but for you to be convicted so that you will repent and give your life to Jesus Christ who loves you and really wants you to make it to heaven at the end of your life here on earth

   “….AND YOU SHALL BE HOLY”
   Leviticus 11:44-45; Zechariah 8:17; Mathew 5:19

YOU should understand that no person can make the rapture or enter heaven without holiness (Heb.12:14). Reason being that God is holy, Heaven is holy and all the dwellers in heaven are holy. If any person who is getting ready or preparing to make heaven is not conscious of holiness such person is wasting his/her time. 

Remember, the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God (1Corinthians.6:9). So, everyone should endeavor to be holy.

We shall consider this message under the following subheadings:-
1.The Reasons and The Fact That Holiness Is Achievable
2.Our Expected Response

1.THE REASONS AND THE FACT THAT HOLINESS IS ACHIEVABLE
We should understand that our God is holy and cannot dwell with unholy person or sinner (Habakkuk 1:13). Holiness is the evidence of the right spirit in us, once we are born-again (saved) by the spirit of God the evidence will be holiness or righteousness (Colossians 3:8-10; 1John 3:9; 2Corinthians 5:17). No one can claim to be born again and continue to take pleasure in sin or unrighteousness (1John 5:18). So, seeing that we have received a nature of holiness, the divine nature of God (Genesis 1:26-27). We should maintain this divine nature to the end (Mathew 5:48). So, we must keep the commandment to be holy (Leviticus 11:44; 1Peter 1:15-16).

Some people have argued or doubted the possibility of one living holy life on this earth, such people should understand that with God all things are possible (Mathew 19:26; Philippians 4:13; 1Corinthians 15:10). It is by the help of God.

2.OUR EXPECTED RESPONSE
Everyone wishing to make the rapture or heaven at last must agree with God that holiness is achievable in this flesh (world) (Mark 9:23, Mathew 5:6). No wonder the Apostle said in (Phil.4:13). If we agree on God’s commandment to be holy and His teachings, we will find the grace to achieve it, in other words, He will help us (Isaiah 42:13-14).

God is ready to help anyone who believe in His word and cry to Him for help (Mark 9:20-26). We all should cry and show God that we believe His word and ready to keep to His commandment and ask Him to help us to be holy and make us holy. He will do it (Mark 9:23-24). His grace is sufficient for us (2Corinthians 12:9). So, we should stop giving excuses why we cannot live holy life. Remember, Christ is coming for the holy, righteous and ready church without spot or wrinkle (Ephesians 5:26-27; Mathew 24:42-44). So, be ye holy in order to make it at last (Leviticus 11:44; 1Peter 1:15-16; Hebrews 12:14)

For those who are not yet born again and backsliders, they should repent of their sins, give their lives to Jesus Christ. If you are into lying, cheating, bitterness, keeping malice, pride, manifesting anger, quarreling, unforgiving, hatred, envy, contention, strife, bitterness, cursing, speaking evil of others, taking or giving bribe, selfishness, deception, kidnapping, smuggling, falsification of documents, swearing, extortion and other sinful character dispositions, you must repent.

comments.text:
🔥 WHAT MUST YOU DO?
The Bible gives us a simple answer.
Romans 10:9 says:
“If you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.”
Salvation is not about simply attending church.
It is not merely about carrying a Bible.
It is not about saying that you are a Christian while your heart remains far from Christ.
Salvation is surrendering your life to Jesus Christ.
Repent of your sins.
Believe in Jesus.
Receive Him as Lord and Savior.
Turn away from your old life and begin walking with Him.
🙏 PRAYER OF SALVATION
If you sincerely want to give your life to Jesus, pray this prayer from your heart:
“Lord Jesus, I come before You today. I acknowledge that I am a sinner and that I cannot save myself. I believe that You died for my sins and that You rose again from the dead. I repent of my sins. Please forgive me and cleanse me. I believe in You and I receive You as my Lord and Savior. Take control of my life. Help me to follow You and live according to Your Word. From today, I belong to You. Thank You for saving me. In Jesus' name, Amen.”
🕊️ IF YOU PRAYED THAT PRAYER
If you sincerely trusted Jesus, begin your new life with Him.
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17:
 “If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”
Start reading the Bible.
Pray every day.
Find a Bible-believing church.
Stay away from sinful influences that pull you away from Christ.
And tell someone about what Jesus has done for you.
🔥 FINAL APPEAL
My friend, Jesus is calling you.
Don't wait until your life is perfect.
Don't wait until tomorrow.
Don't assume you will always have another opportunity.
Today is the day of salvation.
The world can give you temporary pleasure, but Jesus gives you eternal life.
The world can give you possessions, but Jesus gives you peace.
The world can know your past, but Jesus can give you a new beginning.
Come to Jesus.
He loves you.
He died for you.
He rose again for you.
And He is calling you today.
Give your life to Jesus Christ.
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2:
 “Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.”
Jesus is waiting. Come to Him today.
